title: Repository Delivery and Packaging Policy
state_applies_when: Accepted into controlling repository canon; a pending branch or PR is not canonical integration.
decision_authority: Repository owner's explicit approval, recorded as CLOSE-004

delivery_boundary.conversation_role: Originating approval and provenance, preserved substantively in a dated repository decision record.
delivery_boundary.source_of_truth: Reconciled and accepted controlling repository canon, within the accepted record's explicit scope.
closeout_evidence: Retrievable artifact paths or release URLs

artifact_disposition.class: Canonical documents, code, schemas, configuration, generators
artifact_disposition.rule: Versioned source with identifiers, status, and lineage.

artifact_disposition.class: Approved source artwork and canonical visual references
artifact_disposition.rule: Preserve provenance, rights information, and explicit source-artwork exceptions including controlling J2 PNGs.
Regenerate from accepted source and reconcile versions, manifests, and hashes; publications do not independently create canon.

artifact_disposition.class: New distributable ZIP packages and other complete packaged bundles
artifact_disposition.rule: Versioned assets with manifests, SHA-256 checksums, source identity, and limitations; no duplicate current package bytes in Git by default.
Retain deliberately for an identified review or evidence purpose with source lineage; no independent authority.

artifact_disposition.class: Temporary previews, intermediate renders, caches, build debris
artifact_disposition.location: Excluded from Git unless deliberately retained as evidence
artifact_disposition.rule: Local generation is a working step, not delivery.

artifact_disposition.class: Generated institutional JSON and SQLite catalogs
artifact_disposition.rule: Keep current regeneration rules pending separate issue #37 lifecycle decision.

release_rules.discovery: Direct package link or indexed release record.
required_identity: Source commit and relevant canon snapshot
Asset names and retrievable release URLs
Supersession or historical status where applicable
migration_requires: Verify destination retrieval and byte hash

existing_package_inventory.scope: Two ZIP packages tracked in the closeout checkout and the existing finance v0.1.0 GitHub Release; not an inventory of every past commit's artifacts.
existing_package_inventory.local_hash_method: SHA-256 calculated from local tracked ZIP bytes.
existing_package_inventory.release_verification_scope: GitHub API asset metadata/digests and published release record read; no new local download or revalidation of internal manifests claimed.

historical_exceptions.disposition: Retain unchanged in-tree as explicit historical placement exception.
historical_exceptions.reason: Predates approved Pale Sun/Red Wash raster-source overrides and contains noncurrent J2 stationery.
historical_exceptions.future_distribution: Requires a separately built, reviewed, versioned package with current approved assets.

historical_exceptions.disposition: Retain unchanged in-tree as explicit historical placement exception; preserve existing links and prior delivery history.
historical_exceptions.distribution_state_note: No separate distribution-state flag is supplied by the existing manifest; none is invented here.
historical_exceptions.zip_hash_note: New inventory of enclosing ZIP; existing briefing manifest inventories individual outputs.
historical_exceptions.future_revised_version_location: GitHub Release; do not silently overwrite prior ZIP bytes.

releases.disposition: Preserve published snapshot at its existing release location.
releases.nested_manifests: Both ZIPs contain manifests and nested checksum inventories according to the published release record.

documentation_requirements: Stable identifiers, dates, owners where applicable, and status
Synchronized structured records, publications, manifests, and derived catalogs
Historical context and current-facing links to later resolutions

boundaries.issue_35_closeout: Policy and disposition inventory accepted and indexed; historical in-tree exceptions satisfy its justification criterion without migration.
boundaries.issue_37: OPEN; current institutional catalog/SQLite placement and regeneration remain under existing rules.
boundaries.historical_size_audit_treatment: Preserve unchanged as a dated observation; later placement policy controls prospectively within its scope.
boundaries.existing_convenience_renders: Remain unless deliberately reviewed; no deletion or mass reclassification is implied.
